rules.v: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
rules.vi: Instrumen khusus dengan hak lebih sempit, atau hanya pasal tertentu dari hukum umum
rules.n: Private-sector labor law excludes domestic workers; dedicated Law 68/2015 with Ministerial Decisions 2194/2016 and 22/2022.
rules.s: Law 6/2010 art. 5; Law 68/2015; MD 2194/2016; MD 22/2022; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Contract on the form prescribed by the Domestic Workers Department, in English and Arabic (not necessarily a language the worker understands); renewable annually.

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain
rules.n: Minimum wage of KWD 75 a month, the same figure as for the private sector.

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
rules.n: Monthly, within seven days of the due date, against a receipt; KWD 10 penalty for each month of delay.

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Up to 12 hours a day including breaks; the standard contract adds an hour's rest after five hours and 8 consecutive hours of night rest; up to two extra hours paid at half a day's wage.
rules.s: Law 68/2015 art. 22(2); Standard Contract (2020) art. 7(3); MD 22/2022 art. 30

rules.v: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
rules.vi: Istirahat mingguan ada tetapi boleh diganti uang atau hari lain, atau lebih pendek

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: 30 days' paid annual leave after 11 months.

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
rules.vi: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi
rules.n: Confiscation prohibited, but the employer may keep the passport and ID with the worker's consent.

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: Decent food and housing; the worker may own and use a mobile phone and contact family outside working hours.

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Transfer with the employer's permission; without it, only in listed cases (employer's death or departure, divorce, ineligibility or imprisonment, proven sexual misconduct). No exit permit is required.

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
rules.n: Neither the employer nor the recruitment agency may recover recruitment costs from the worker; agencies may not charge "advance wages".

rules.v: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
rules.vi: Agen berizin dan bertanggung jawab kepada pekerja (pengembalian, biaya pulang atau tanggung renteng)
rules.n: Licensed offices; liability during the probation period.

rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
rules.n: Domestic Workers Department investigates and decides within two weeks; unresolved cases go to the Civil Court (Labour Circuit) free of court fees.
rules.s: MD 22/2022 art. 34; CoM Decision 614/2018; ILO factsheet

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: Mandatory employer-paid health insurance; injury treatment and compensation in the contract; end-of-service pay of one month per year. No sick or maternity leave in the law.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum
rules.n: Harmful, dangerous or degrading work prohibited; government shelter for women workers (since 2014).

rules.vi: Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
rules.n: No provision enabling domestic workers to join a trade union.

Law on Labor in the Private Sector
Ministerial Decision issuing the Implementing Regulations of the Domestic Workers Law
laws.or_: قرار وزاري بإصدار اللائحة التنفيذية لقانون العمالة المنزلية

laws.ti: Decree-Law on the Residence of Foreigners
laws.or_: مرسوم بقانون في شأن إقامة الأجانب

laws.or_: قانون في شأن مكافحة الاتجار بالأشخاص وتهريب المهاجرين

laws.or_: قرار حظر العمل في الأماكن المكشوفة وقت الظهيرة

laws.ti: Ministry of Justice legislation portal (labor disputes and courts)
Ministerial Decision No. 22 of 2022 on Domestic Workers

decisions.nm: Domestic worker leaving before the end of her contract
decisions.pe: An employer in Kuwait took a domestic worker to court for leaving before her two-year contract ended. The court rejected the case. Reports say a worker cannot be forced to stay.
decisions.pi: Seorang majikan di Kuwait menggugat pekerja rumah tangga yang berhenti sebelum kontrak dua tahunnya selesai. Pengadilan menolak gugatan itu. Menurut laporan, pekerja tidak bisa dipaksa bertahan.

decisions.nm: Recruitment offices’ challenge to the Domestic Workers Law
decisions.pe: Ten domestic worker recruitment offices said the law was unfair to them because it made them send workers home and repay employers in some cases. The Constitutional Court rejected their challenge.
decisions.pi: Sepuluh kantor perekrut pekerja rumah tangga berpendapat UU tidak adil karena mewajibkan mereka memulangkan pekerja dan mengembalikan uang majikan dalam kasus tertentu. MK menolak gugatan mereka.

decisions.nm: Qualifications for owners of domestic worker offices
decisions.pe: Kuwait’s new domestic workers law set education and health conditions for people who own recruitment offices. The Constitutional Court struck down that clause. The case concerns office owners, not workers, but shapes how recruitment is regulated.
decisions.pi: UU pekerja rumah tangga Kuwait yang baru menetapkan syarat pendidikan dan kesehatan bagi pemilik kantor perekrut. MK membatalkan klausul itu. Perkara ini menyangkut pemilik kantor, bukan pekerja, tetapi memengaruhi cara perekrutan diatur.

help.de: Government body for labor complaints and disputes. Cases that go to the labor court can get a lawyer if the worker cannot pay.
help.di: Lembaga pemerintah untuk pengaduan dan perselisihan ketenagakerjaan. Kasus yang dibawa ke pengadilan perburuhan bisa mendapat pengacara jika pekerja tidak mampu membayar.

help.de: Takes labor complaints from migrant workers on its hotline and follows up cases with its own lawyers. Hotline languages have included Arabic, English, Filipino, Hindi and Urdu.
help.di: Menerima pengaduan ketenagakerjaan dari pekerja migran melalui saluran bantuan dan menindaklanjuti kasus dengan pengacaranya sendiri. Saluran bantuan pernah melayani bahasa Arab, Inggris, Filipina, Hindi dan Urdu.
